items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: We went to Rudy Van Gelder’s (a) because it’s a great studio... So we got upstate. And we rehearsed a little bit... And then I think we had planned to do one gig... but in the end we didn’t do it. So we just rehearsed a little more and we went into Van Gelder’s.

ctx.x: When you finally got back together with any of your ensembles, did you notice a positive difference with most of your fellow musicians because of what you’re describing?

I don’t have the full gamut yet because I haven’t, I really haven’t gotten together with anybody but the Cookers. One thing Covid has done is the casual get together I guess, I mean why have a jam session if you’ve got to put people at risk? So I mean I’ve always been a bit of a hermit so I’ve stayed in. I haven’t done anything with any other bands but the Cookers so I could only relate to them. And that was an interesting phenomenon. You’re talking about guys that have gone like at a breakneck pace for fifty…

their thing for months. I just needed a few days. So we went upstate to a club I knew up there that was pretty large and comfortable and not open, and they let us use the place. We went up there for a couple of days and rehearsed. And then like everywhere, all I was trying to do was like out of the city, where people could just drive up to the place, not be on a subway, not be in a building or an elevator, nothing that would put anybody in potential harm’s way. So we got upstate. And we rehearsed a little bit,…
